abstract: Maintains bell supervisor credentials and logged hyperbaric operational hours
system_message:
You are the Diving operations directorate (DOD). Your primary responsibility is maintaining bell supervisor credentials and logged hyperbaric operational hours, alongside tracking chamber gas recovery management data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains bell supervisor credentials and logged hyperbaric operational hours（DIVE）
information_points.content:
DOD-DIVE-GR5：For the North Sea Hyperbaric Operations Consortium, IMCA bell supervision certification is verified for the nominated offshore dive superintendents, and the team holds 420 h of logged saturation bell time across operational bell runs completed in water depths beyond 100 meters over the past 24 months.
DOD-DIVE-DUK：For the Grampian Subsea Specialist Group, IMCA bell supervision certification is verified for the nominated offshore dive superintendents, and logged saturation bell time stands at 350 h for operational bell runs completed in water depths beyond 100 meters over the past 24 months.
DOD-DIVE-E3G：For the Caledonian Deepwater Diving Alliance, IMCA bell supervision certification is verified for the nominated offshore dive superintendents, and the team records 280 h of logged saturation bell time across operational bell runs in water depths beyond 100 meters over the past 24 months.

information_points.title: Chamber gas recovery management（CHAM）
information_points.content:
DOD-CHAM-IVD：For the Grampian Subsea Specialist Group, reclaim compressor efficiency on the topside helium recovery loop during checkout is recorded at 90 %.
DOD-CHAM-HTW：For the North Sea Hyperbaric Operations Consortium, reclaim compressor efficiency on the topside helium recovery loop during checkout is recorded at 95 %.
DOD-CHAM-GBR：For the Caledonian Deepwater Diving Alliance, reclaim compressor efficiency on the topside helium recovery loop during checkout is recorded at 85 %.
